headline: Pantera Back
caption:
Yair Rodriguez is reportedly coming back against knockout artist Steve Garcia at UFC 335.
Pantera or Garcia? 👇

The former interim featherweight champ hasn't fought since April 2025; Garcia (19-6) is coming off a KO loss to Diego Lopes. UFC 335 is set for Dec. 12, with Oliveira vs. Lopes on top.

🔥 Hot take: Yair vs. Garcia is the most violent fight on the card.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Pantera or Garcia?
hot_take: Yair vs Garcia is the most *violent* fight on the card.
